groups.problem: getBaseConditions contains unreachable fallback branches because authorization conditions are always a truthy Prisma.Sql object.
groups.rationale: Both suggestions identify the same unreachable else-if and else branches and attribute them to the truthiness of authorization conditions, including NOTHING_CONDITION.

groups.problem: InsightsBookingServicePublicOptions permits team scope without teamId although runtime validation requires it.
groups.rationale: Both report the same mismatch between the public type and the validated schema, causing accepted TypeScript inputs to fail validation and silently produce empty results.
